Title: LSJ: some questions and a suggestion

Messages.Author: tetragr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Some questions:
1. What if the Shadow Court Satyr uses its ability with a ZipGun?
Does he takes the point of damage or not, he simply uses the
(opt) maneuver and the
1R strike without any other effect?
What if i put on the Satyr an Ammo Card? If the Satyr then uses a
Gun and trigger its abilty to increase the gun's damage, can i still
play another ammo card on that Gun (in the same combat?).
And the Satyr must use its ability as a strike at all or he get its
strike AND its ability card's effect?
For these questions on the Satyr i'm refering on the text found on
the Sabbat Spoiler list, since here in Rome i never been able to see
a Shadow Court Satyr card (we got so VERY few Sabbat boxes
here..).

2. Are the blood put on Alamut considered counters in regard of
the Goth Band's ability? I think (and played) yes, but i would like
a ruling here.

3. The Blood Brother Ambush is considered only a act modifier when is
not in play, and
only an ally when he is in play.
This means that a Compel the Spirit cannot be used
to take back from the Ash Heap the Blood Brothers the turn after is
burned in combat?
That would be funny...

and a suggestion:
For a better game terminology, i think that for the future Vtes
reprintings the text about an action a Vampire/Ally can
performs by its own special ability(ies) should read:

"As a X blood (life) cost action, VAMPXXXX / ALLYXXXX can...."
(Say, for Al-Ashrad: "As a 2 blood cost (D) action, Al-Ashrad can
burn a Location requiring..." etc.).

Hope this help, and thank you very much in advance for your response.
Aemilianus, Prince of Rome.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 18 Mar 2000 tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Some questions:
> 1. What if the Shadow Court Satyr uses its ability with a ZipGun?
> Does he takes the point of damage or not, he simply uses the
> (opt) maneuver and the
> 1R strike without any other effect?

He would take the damage. However, it would seem vastly more sensible to
just put a Zip Gun on the SCS in combat as normal, rather than using its
ability.

> What if i put on the Satyr an Ammo Card? If the Satyr then uses a
> Gun and trigger its abilty to increase the gun's damage, can i still
> play another ammo card on that Gun (in the same combat?).

No, because the ammo card on the Satyr is still an ammo card when he uses
it. Hence, it isn't stackable (by ammo card text).

> And the Satyr must use its ability as a strike at all or he get its
> strike AND its ability card's effect?

I don't understand the question, exactly.

The Satyr is under no compunction to use the card which is given to
it. He can use it (once per combat) if he wants to, but not if he does
not.

> 2. Are the blood put on Alamut considered counters in regard of
> the Goth Band's ability? I think (and played) yes, but i would like
> a ruling here.

They are counters on a master card in play, so yes.

> 3. The Blood Brother Ambush is considered only a act modifier when is
> not in play, and
> only an ally when he is in play.
> This means that a Compel the Spirit cannot be used
> to take back from the Ash Heap the Blood Brothers the turn after is
> burned in combat?

It cannot be done, because it is not an ally in the ash-heap.

> "As a X blood (life) cost action, VAMPXXXX / ALLYXXXX can...."
> (Say, for Al-Ashrad: "As a 2 blood cost (D) action, Al-Ashrad can
> burn a Location requiring..." etc.).

If you check the errata, several vampires (e.g. Kalinda) are re-written as
such, though the intent was there.

--

James Coupe
